-- 20261001000000_bookmarks — create public.bookmarks, an org's shared links.
--
-- APPLIED HISTORY, NOT DESIRED STATE. The declarative source is
-- supabase/schemas/50_bookmarks.sql; this file is the `supabase db diff -f bookmarks`
-- draft, read and re-cased. Append-only: it is never edited once committed.
CREATE TABLE public.bookmarks (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  -- The TENANT KEY. Every policy filters by it, and the freeze trigger keeps a row in
  -- the org that wrote it.
  org_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  url text NOT NULL,
  label text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  -- Bounds, not validation: the zod DTO is the input contract. These hold for callers
  -- that reach the table by another path.
  CONSTRAINT bookmarks_url_length CHECK (char_length(url) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
  CONSTRAINT bookmarks_label_length CHECK (char_length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  -- The tenant column leads the primary key, as on every tenant table.
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, id)
);

CREATE TRIGGER bookmarks_set_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.bookmarks
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at();

-- The tenant column LEADS, so every policy's qual is an Index Cond, and the trailing
-- (created_at DESC, id DESC) is the list's keyset order.
-- SOURCE: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/indexes-multicolumn.html
CREATE INDEX bookmarks_org_id_created_at_id_idx
  ON public.bookmarks (org_id, created_at DESC, id DESC);

-- org_id is immutable: without this an UPDATE that passes its own policy could hand
-- the row to another tenant. No WHEN clause.
CREATE TRIGGER bookmarks_freeze_org
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.bookmarks
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.freeze_org_id();

-- Every org-scoped table is audited, with no WHEN clause (docs/adr/20260202-audit-trail.md).
CREATE TRIGGER bookmarks_audit
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.bookmarks
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.write_row('org_id', 'id');

-- FORCE subjects the table owner to these policies as well.
-- SOURCE: PostgreSQL row security — FORCE applies row security to the table owner as
-- well [corpus: postgres/rls-force]
ALTER TABLE public.bookmarks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.bookmarks FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Grants are the outer gate: anon has no business here, and service_role's grant is
-- revoked because BYPASSRLS makes the grant the only lever over it.
-- SOURCE: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/ddl-priv.html
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.bookmarks FROM anon;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.bookmarks FROM service_role;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.bookmarks TO authenticated;

-- Four per-operation policies, TO authenticated, each drawn from the predicate forms in
-- tools/tenancy.json. Reading is membership; writing is rank.
-- SOURCE: RLS performance — wrap the identity call in a scalar sub-select for an
-- initPlan [corpus: postgres/rls-initplan]
CREATE POLICY bookmarks_select_org ON public.bookmarks
  AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (org_id = ANY((SELECT private.member_org_ids())::uuid[]));

-- SOURCE: PostgreSQL row security — WITH CHECK validates the new row [corpus: postgres/rls-force]
CREATE POLICY bookmarks_insert_org ON public.bookmarks
  AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (coalesce(((SELECT private.member_ranks()) ->> org_id::text)::smallint, 0) >= 20);

-- SOURCE: PostgreSQL row security — UPDATE evaluates USING then WITH CHECK [corpus: postgres/rls-force]
CREATE POLICY bookmarks_update_org ON public.bookmarks
  AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (coalesce(((SELECT private.member_ranks()) ->> org_id::text)::smallint, 0) >= 20)
  WITH CHECK (coalesce(((SELECT private.member_ranks()) ->> org_id::text)::smallint, 0) >= 20);

-- SOURCE: PostgreSQL row security — DELETE USING restricts which rows the role may
-- remove [corpus: postgres/rls-force]
CREATE POLICY bookmarks_delete_org ON public.bookmarks
  AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (coalesce(((SELECT private.member_ranks()) ->> org_id::text)::smallint, 0) >= 20);
